item.title: North American Publishing Company Changes Name to NAPCO Media
item.description: PHILADELPHIA—January 5, 2015 —U.S.-based North American Publishing Company has announced it is now doing business as NAPCO Media. The new name better represents its evolving portfolio of services while maintaining the brand equity from the company’s inception in 1958. According to NAPCO Media Chairman Ned Borowsky, “the term ‘publishing’ no longer defines who we are as...
